utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: A few things still need attention—some loose wiring, a leaky faucet, and that broken fence panel by the alley.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—what should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can help out with that repair drive—I've got a few tools I can lend if you need them. What are you working on?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Gus—thanks. I was just thinking of gathering whatever people can spare; maybe a few tools and some odds and ends would help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds like a good plan. I can bring over a toolbox and a few spare odds and ends to add to the pile.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they're trying to get everything wrapped up by the weekend, so folks can drop things off any day this week.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, but I’m a little worried about the timing—do we know when they’re actually collecting the repairs? I don’t want to show up and miss it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think they’re collecting every afternoon through Friday, around 3 to 6. If you want, I can double-check the exact hours for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you bring any spare tools and some duct tape? If you can, meet me at the community shed around 4.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring whatever spare tools I have and some duct tape, and I’ll meet you at the community shed around 4.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—it’s such a good cause. If you’re free, I’d love for you to come by and help out!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Quinn. I can stop by if I’m able that day.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That would be great, Uli—thank you! Just swing by whenever you can, and I’ll save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help get the repair drive organized. Let me know what supplies or volunteers you need, and I’ll start coordinating.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. We need a few volunteers, some gloves, trash bags, and a pickup truck if anyone has one.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll start asking around for volunteers, gloves, trash bags, and a pickup truck right away. I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to be sure, what exactly needs repairing at the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the loose fence panels and that broken lamp post by the entrance. I can help check the rest once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—loose fence panels and the broken lamp post by the entrance. I’ll make a quick list and check for anything else before we start.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off if that makes the repair drive easier. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Faye. I’m thinking we could aim for around 3:30, right after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 works for me—I can swing by right after pickup and help coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks were gathering for the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, a few things are still open—mainly sorting tools, carrying supplies, and checking in on the broken benches. If you’re free, I could use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help with that—what should I grab first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the repair drive details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great—can you confirm you want the repair drive details sent over, and I’ll make sure you get them?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, send them over and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive's coming up soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you for asking! I could use help sorting the tools and maybe carrying a few things over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. Just let me know when and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik, I really appreciate that. I’ll keep track of the supplies and make sure we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem, Cleo — I’ll remind people and pass along the details as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming along nicely. If you need, I can keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that. If you hear anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive—I'm sorry, I blanked for a second. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — could you help spread the word about the repair drive? I’m trying to get folks lined up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I can do that. I’ll mention it to a few neighbors and help get people lined up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still going on—I've got a few items to drop off this afternoon. If you want, I can swing by and grab yours too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, thanks. I’m pretty sure I’ve got a box of stuff by the door—if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m in—happy to bring whatever tools we need for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s on the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: a hammer, screwdrivers, a drill, and a tape measure should cover most of it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll grab a hammer, screwdrivers, a drill, and a tape measure. Just say the word if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — could you start by sharing the invite with a few neighbors and asking who can lend tools or help on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll share the invite with a few neighbors and ask who can lend tools or help on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help get the repair drive rolling—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules—could you tell me where the repair drive will be held and what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — it’ll be at the community hall, and it starts at 10 a.m. I can help point people there too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to bring their items. Let’s get the word out and keep it running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye on our supply list and let you know what we’re low on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — I’ll watch for any gaps and update the neighbors if we need more hands or supplies. Thanks for helping keep it all on track.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for letting me know about the repair drive. I haven’t heard much yet, but I’d like to help if there’s still something needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Nell. We still need a few hands to sort donations and hand out flyers—would you be able to help this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I can help this Saturday. Just let me know what time and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the main thing you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly getting the donations sorted and matching them up with the school pickup times. If you can help with that, it’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with that. Just send me the pickup times and donation list, and I’ll sort through it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great—can you confirm you’re still in for it and tell me which part you can cover?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still in for it. I can cover the drop-off and sorting part.
